task1.title: Request for a Job Recommendation
task1.prompt:
You are preparing to apply for a new job and would like to request a recommendation letter from your former manager. Write a letter to your former manager. In your letter, you should: 1. Briefly explain your reason for applying for the new job. 2. Mention any skills or experiences that you would like them to highlight in the recommendation. 3. Provide details about the deadline for the letter and how they can submit it.

Begin your letter with a proper greeting and end it with a professional closing.

task2.title: The Impact of Technology on Communication
task2.prompt: Modern technology has significantly changed the way people communicate with one another. While some argue that technology has improved communication, others believe it has led to a decline in face-to-face interaction. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. In your essay, include specific examples and reasons to support your arguments. Your response should be at least 250 words.
